engines.label: demo1 — cautious swap
engines.entry_rule: A confirmed EMA13/21 cross on candle close enters immediately. The old gap-size/EMA5-pullback branching (small gap = immediate entry, large gap = wait for a pullback to EMA5) was tried, then removed entirely on 2026-08-31 — every confirmed cross now enters directly, on every account.
engines.swap_rule: On a fresh opposing cross, the engine requires 2 consecutive confirming candles AND ADX(14) >= 25 before actually reversing the position — a lower ADX threshold was tested against real blocked signals and found to change nothing, so 25 stayed. If the ADX gate blocks the reversal, the ORIGINAL position's stop-loss is halved the moment the first opposing candle appears (pending-reversal stop-tightening, live since 2026-08-24) — protection kicks in even when the swap itself doesn't happen.
engines.breakeven_rule: demo1_m1 only: once floating profit reaches $4.50 (90% of the $5 take-profit), the stop-loss moves to the entry price, so a trade that nearly hits its target and then reverses closes flat instead of at a full loss. demo1_m3 does not have this — M1 timeframe only, by explicit design.

engines.label: demo2 — immediate swap
engines.entry_rule: Same confirmed EMA13/21 cross, immediate entry — no gap-size branching, same as demo1's engine.
engines.swap_rule: Reverses immediately on the very first confirming opposing candle — no 2-candle debounce, no ADX gate, no pending-reversal stop-tightening. Built deliberately simpler than demo1's engine, specifically to be demo1's real-data A/B comparison partner (see the demo1-vs-demo2 comparison tab): the standing question is whether demo1's extra caution here is actually worth its cost in missed/delayed trades.
engines.breakeven_rule: demo2_m1 only: same $4.50-of-$5 trigger as demo1_m1, moves stop to entry. demo2_m3 does not have this — M1 timeframe only.

notes: gap_threshold_usd is set to 999999.0 (effectively infinite) on all four accounts as of 2026-08-31 — this is how the old gap/EMA5-pullback code path is disabled without removing the field itself.
Sessions are Sri Lanka time (Asia/Colombo, fixed UTC+5:30, no daylight saving).
